name: Saiga-12 (12 gauge, suppressed)

sights.note: MG12: first estimate from the static mesh's top profile; refined on the rig (animated.points)

note: Magazine-fed semi-automatic shotgun (Saiga-12 type, 12 gauge, 8-round box, 8 buckshot pellets per shell), suppressor fitted, rail. Modern weapons case only. The supplied arms rig is not used (its skin is broken): the gun is held by the game's arms.
